sasha: pushed new Grafana dashboard 'hitmap telemetry rollup' — per-model / per-route / per-tenant hit-rate and token-saved. link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd123/hitmap-rollup
mohit: looked — nice baseline. can we show kernel_tag and batching_bucket as labels? that'll help correlate kernel selection changes

ivan: agree. add a 1h/24h drop alert (>=5% relative) and a token-saved delta panel

```promql
sum(rate(prefix_cache_hits{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(prefix_cache_requests{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
```
mohit: maybe use histogram_quantile for token-saved distribution? plus a p95 for per-request token_savings
tara: can we include tenant_cohort tag (free/paid/enterprise) so sales can see impact
